subject.why: Clearly depicts an old-time steam train with all key components present.

category.why: Properly grounded on tracks in a stylized desert environment with a low heroic angle.

clean.why: Free of text, numbers, UI, and characters.

framing.why: Well-centered chunky silhouette with balanced margins around the object.

detail.why: Clean surfaces without micro-textures or excessive clutter.

style.why: Matches reference rendering with smooth, chunky shapes and soft satin highlights.
